newsitem.title: USA: CBL & Associates to manage Utah mall.
newsitem.headline: CBL & Associates to manage Utah mall.

text.p: CBL & Associates Properties Inc on Tuesday said its CBL & Associates Management Inc unit won a contract to manage Ogden City Mall in Ogden, Utah.
The 800,000-square-foot mall is owned by Connecticut General Life Insurance Co.
Terms of the contract were not disclosed. CBL officials were not immediately available to comment.
The mall, opened in 1980 and renovated in 1995, features stores operated by retailers Nordstrom Inc and J.C. Penney Co Inc, the company said.
CBL said it has been a receiver of the mall since April and as a result of the contract will fully operate it.
CBL is a real estate investment trust with a portfolio of 109 regional mall and shopping center properties with a total of about 20.5 million square feet of floor space, it said.
